response: You can send up to 10,000.00 in a single transfer and up to 25,000.00 per account per day (UTC).
Transfers between your own accounts at the bank are free of charge.
International wires cost a flat 15.00 plus 1% of the amount.
For security I can't share PINs. You can reset it in the mobile app under Card > Reset PIN.
I'm not able to give investment advice. A licensed financial advisor can help you weigh options like that.
Transfers above 10,000.00 are not allowed, so 10,000 was over the limit.
Please don't share one-time passcodes with anyone, including us. I haven't used it. If you think it was exposed, change your password in the app.
